# mangacn

> 1 shadcn/ui registry items that redraw shadcn in a manga style (ink, paper, screentone) with a webtoon theme (data-theme="webtoon"). MIT. Installed with the shadcn CLI straight from GitHub.

Install any item: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/<item>`
Every item depends on `Romcharted/mangacn/base` (tokens, screentone utilities, animations), installed automatically.
Restyled shadcn components install to `@ui/manga/<name>.tsx` and wrap the project's own `@/components/ui/<name>` (works with Radix and Base UI).
Homepage: https://romcharted.github.io/mangacn

## Items

### Manga base (`base`)

Shared foundation for every mangacn item: ink/paper/stamp-red tokens mapped onto shadcn variables (dark mode is the negative), a webtoon theme under data-theme="webtoon", screentone utilities (tone-10/20/35/50, tone-lines, tone-cross, tone-fade-r/l/t/b), speed-lines and focus-lines backgrounds, tone-shadow (offset screentone, never a blur), ink-fill, focus-ink, border-ink, shape-burst, edge-jagged and stepped 12 fps animations (animate-impact, -shake, -pop, -spin-steps, -draw, -enter, -sfx, -wiggle, -tone-flicker). Installed automatically as a dependency of every other item; install it alone to restyle stock shadcn/ui.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add Romcharted/mangacn/base`
- Categories: foundations

```tsx
<div className="relative border-ink tone-shadow tone-20 p-6">
  <h2 className="font-letter text-2xl">Chapter 1</h2>
</div>
```
